Ord No. 0996-22  

Be it ordained by the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Davao City in session assembled, that:  

SECTION 1. TITLE - This Ordinance shall be known as "AN ORDINANCE GIVING AUTHORITY TO THE CITY MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AND SIGN, FOR AND IN BEHALF OF THE CITY OF DAVAO, THE DEEDS OF SALE INVOLVING THE LOTS UNDER THE SLUM IMPROVEMENT AND RESETTLEMENT PROJECT (SIR PROJECT), IN FAVOR OF THE AWARDES, NAMELY: SUSAN A. CALAGO-PALMA, DANTE M. ZABALLERO, TOMAS REMOTICADO JR. AND ARTURO R. LAURENTE".  

SECTION 2. AUTHORITY - The City Mayor is hereby authorized to enter into and sign, for and in behalf of the City of Davao, the Deeds of Sale involving the lots under the Slum Improvement and Resettlement Project (SIR Project), in favor of the awardees namely: Susan A. Calago-Palma, Dante M. Zaballero, Tomas Remoticado Jr. and Arturo R. Laurente.  

SECTION 3. SEPARABILITY CLAUSE - If for any reason, any section or provision of this Ordinance is declared unconstitutional or invalid, other sections or provisions hereof not affected by such declaration shall continue to be in full force and effect.  

ENACTED, on the 28th of June, 2022, by an unanimous vote of all the Members of the Sanggunian present.  

CERTIFIED CORRECT:  
Charito N. Santos
